title: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Government Tenders Scraper

listType.title: List type
listType.description: "Current" = bids open for submission right now (~20 at a time), each linking directly to its bid/ToR PDF. "Closed" = the historical archive of the same table (400+ records). "Awards" = one row per calendar year (2017-2025) linking to the Central Procurement Board's quarterly "Award of Contracts" PDF bundles (not individual contract-level records -- SVG only publishes these as periodic documents).

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Caps how many records are kept in the output for this run.
